name: authorize-every-method
why: the grant widens from one method to all

files.before:
apiVersion: vikrant.smallstepgiantleap.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: hello
spec:
  language: go
  proto: proto/hello/v1/hello.proto
  authorizedCallers:
    - service: smallStepGiantLeap/frontend
      methods: [hello.v1.HelloService/Hello]
  ingress:
    - service: smallStepGiantLeap/frontend
files.after:
apiVersion: vikrant.smallstepgiantleap.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: hello
spec:
  language: go
  proto: proto/hello/v1/hello.proto
  authorizedCallers:
    - service: smallStepGiantLeap/frontend
      methods: ["*"]
  ingress:
    - service: smallStepGiantLeap/frontend
